info.title: plori REST API
info.summary: Create cloud AI agents, send them work, read the results.
info.description: The documented REST surface of api.plori.ai: agents, runs, schedules, credits, GitHub Actions workload identity, and the public rate cards. Account endpoints authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <plori_sk_ API key>` (minted in the dashboard or via `plori login`) or an OAuth 2.1 access token from the same flow MCP clients use. See https://plori.ai/auth.md. GitHub Actions instead exchange a signed OIDC JWT for a narrow single-run capability. Run OUTPUT is read over the session WebSocket (`GET /v1/ws`) or the MCP/CLI surfaces; `POST .../runs` is submit-only and returns 202. This document lists the supported public endpoints; other paths served by the API are internal and may change without notice.

post.summary: Create an agent (or get-or-create by name)
post.description: Creates a cloud agent owned by the authenticated account. With `if_exists: "return"` this is get-or-create: if an agent with the same name exists, it is returned (200, `existing: true`) instead of creating a duplicate. Prefer this and one long-lived agent. The owner is always the credential's account; a `user_id` in the body is ignored.

model.description: Model slug; omit for the Plori Router default.

403.description: Plan does not allow the requested model tier.

get.summary: Read one window of a text file on an agent's disk
get.description: Returns `text/plain` for a text file. This is the editor route: a file that is not text answers 415, and a file over the 2 MiB text cap answers 413 unless a window was asked for. Both refusals carry a `download_url` for the route that does serve those bytes. Use `offset` and `limit` to page through a file of any size; every 200 states what it covered in `X-File-Offset`, `X-File-Returned-Bytes`, `X-File-Size` and `X-File-Truncated`, so a short body is never silent. The disk is served directly, so an idle agent's files are readable with no running pod.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: The file's path on the agent's disk, rooted at the disk root.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Byte offset of the first byte to return. Default 0.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many bytes to return, clamped to the 2 MiB per-call cap. Absent or 0 means the cap.

200.description: The requested window of the file, as text.

X-File-Size.description: Size of the whole file in bytes.

X-File-Offset.description: Byte offset this body starts at.

X-File-Returned-Bytes.description: How many bytes this body carries.

X-File-Truncated.description: true when bytes remain past this window.

ETag.description: The file's version, for a compare-and-swap write.

413.description: The file is over the text cap and no window was asked for. The body carries `size`, `cap` and `download_url`.

415.description: The file is not text. The body carries `download_url` for the route that streams its bytes.

get.summary: Download one file from an agent's disk
get.description: Streams a file's bytes — text or binary, any size the account can hold — with its own content type for known extensions and `application/octet-stream` otherwise. This is the route a file link in an agent's reply resolves to. The disk is served directly, so an idle agent's files are downloadable with no running pod.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: The file's path on the agent's disk, rooted at the disk root.

200.description: The file's bytes. `Content-Disposition` is always an attachment, and `X-File-Size` carries the size the disk reported before the stream started.

X-File-Size.description: Size of the file in bytes, as of the stat that preceded the stream.

400.description: No path was given, or the path is a directory (`error: "is a directory"`) — list it instead.

post.summary: Send the agent a message (submit a run)
post.description: Submits a run and returns 202 immediately; there is no blocking or SSE mode on this endpoint. Read the reply over the session WebSocket (`GET /v1/ws`), poll `GET /v1/agents/{agentID}/runs/{runID}` for status, or use the MCP `invoke_agent` tool, which can wait. A run is nondeterministic and billable. Retry only with an `Idempotency-Key`: the same key replays the original run for 24 h (the replay carries `X-Plori-Idempotent-Replay: true`).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-chosen retry key; wins over the body's `idempotency_key`.

message.description: The user message. Exactly one of `message` or `messages` is required; `messages` wins if both are set.

session_id.description: Continue an existing thread; omit to start a new one.

max_turn_tokens.description: Cap for this turn; 0 or omitted = the default budget.

max_advisor_spend_micro_usd.description: Advisor completion cap for the turn in micro-USD. Omit the field to use the agent cap. Set 0 to disable advisor completions.

max_turn_seconds.description: Soft checkpoint for this turn; 0 or omitted = the default.

github_token.description: Job-lifetime contents:read GITHUB_TOKEN for repository checkout. Delivered only to this turn in memory and never persisted; the owning API-key fallback is supported for GHES.

github_server_url.description: HTTPS origin that issued github_token, such as https://github.com or a GHES origin. The token's in-memory Git credential helper is scoped to this host; invalid values fall back to github.com.

202.description: Run submitted. Headers `X-Plori-Run-Id` and `X-Plori-Session-Id` mirror the body.

409.description: A request with this Idempotency-Key is still in flight. `Retry-After: 2`.

422.description: This Idempotency-Key was already used for a different request.

429.description: Plan concurrency cap or cluster capacity. `Retry-After: 10`.

post.description: Requests cancellation; cascades to any child runs the run delegated to.

A direct owner session using the owner's plori_sk_ API key outside MCP creates a pending schedule. An MCP request or OAuth access token creates an awaiting_confirmation schedule with confirm_url. It cannot fire until the owner confirms. Unconfirmed rows have no expiry sweep.

fire_at.description: RFC3339 UTC. Exactly one of `fire_at` or `delay_seconds`.

session_id.description: Pin the thread; omit for the agent's active thread.

delete.summary: Cancel an unconfirmed, pending, or dispatched schedule
delete.description: Returns the updated schedule (200, not 204). A schedule that already fired is a 404 because there is nothing left to cancel.

get.summary: Get the account's credit balance and plan
get.description: `userID` must be the authenticated account's own id (anything else is 403). Check the balance before taking on long work.

post.summary: Confirm a deferred schedule as the account owner
post.description: Requires the owner's own plori_sk_ API key outside MCP. Takes no body. Changes awaiting_confirmation to pending and records confirmed_at only while fire_at is in the future. An already confirmed row returns 200 unchanged. MCP and OAuth requests receive 403 with the confirmation link in the error text.

403.description: AI clients cannot confirm; the error text includes the owner's confirmation link. Another account's agent is also forbidden.

404.description: Agent or schedule not found, or schedule outside the addressed agent.

409.description: Unconfirmed fire time has passed, the row's state cannot be confirmed and confirmed_at is unset, or the agent is being deleted (code: agent_deleting).

post.summary: Exchange GitHub Actions workload identity for one run
post.description: Verifies a GitHub Actions OIDC JWT minted for audience `plori.ai`, resolves the repository's persistent agent, and returns a short-lived single-run capability. Public repositories receive up to 3 free runs per repository and 10 per GitHub owner per UTC month while unclaimed. Private repositories and exhausted public repositories receive a claim URL instead. This endpoint never creates a customer account or API key.

token.description: GitHub Actions OIDC JWT with audience plori.ai.

200.description: Repository identity accepted; use this capability once on POST /v1/agents/{agentID}/runs.

401.description: OIDC signature, issuer, audience, lifetime, or repository claims are invalid.

402.description: Repository must be claimed before it can run. The body includes a signed claim URL.

409.description: The repository agent is being provisioned. Retry after the indicated delay.

post.summary: Attach a verified repository to the signed-in account
post.description: Combines the signed repository claim capability from a workflow with a registered Plori payer identity. The same repository agent, disk, threads, and private memory move to that account. Safe to retry by the same account.

200.description: Repository attached or already attached to this account.

409.description: Repository belongs to another account; contact support for a transfer.

get.summary: Poll one GitHub-triggered run's durable event stream
get.description: Returns AG-UI events after `after_seq`. A GitHub capability is scoped to its repository agent; the manual API-key fallback can read only runs owned by that account.

200.description: Current status and the next durable event page.

cause.description: Machine-readable terminal cause. Empty while the run is active and after normal completion.

200.description: Per-model token rates at the provider's real cost, no markup. Amounts are micro-USD (µ$), where 1,000,000 µ$ = $1.

get.summary: Public tool and workflow rate card

200.description: Per-tool rates and workflow run pricing, in micro-USD (µ$), where 1,000,000 µ$ = $1.

bearerAuth.description: A plori API key (plori_sk_…) or an OAuth 2.1 access token. How to get either: https://plori.ai/auth.md

githubRunAuth.description: A short-lived `plori_ghr_` capability returned only by the GitHub OIDC exchange. It submits exactly one run to one repository agent and polls only that run.

Forbidden.description: The resource belongs to another account.

request_id.description: Present on 500 responses, whose error message is always the fixed string "internal error": quote this id to support to locate the failure.

status.description: Warm-session state when known: warming, ready, or sleeping.

deleting.description: True while this agent's disk is still being erased. The agent offers no actions except deletion itself, which is idempotent and the only way to finish a stuck one.

deleting_since.description: When the erasure was first asked for. Absent when the agent is not being deleted.

moving.description: True while this agent's files are being copied to a new disk. Poll the migration progress route only while this is true.

Run.description: Run status and accounting. The run's OUTPUT is not in this DTO. Read it over the session WebSocket or the MCP get_run_result tool.

credits.description: Amount charged for the run, in micro-USD (µ$), where 1,000,000 µ$ = $1.

status.description: AI-client-created schedules await owner confirmation. done does not establish task success; inspect the run outcome.

confirmed_at.description: Time the owner confirmed the schedule. Absent when unset.

confirm_url.description: Owner confirmation page. Present only for awaiting_confirmation schedules.

balance.description: Wallet balance in micro-USD (µ$), where 1,000,000 µ$ = $1. The wallet keeps the name 'credits' but every amount is US dollars.

peg_cents.description: Deprecated. Amounts are micro-USD (µ$), where 1,000,000 µ$ = $1; use that conversion rather than a credits-per-dollar rate.

usd_cents.description: Purchase price in whole US cents.

credits.description: Balance granted, in micro-USD (µ$). Packs are flat: the µ$ granted equals usd_cents × 10,000.

usd_cents.description: Monthly price in whole US cents.

credits_per_usd.description: Deprecated. Amounts are micro-USD (µ$), where 1,000,000 µ$ = $1.

peg_cents.description: Deprecated. Amounts are micro-USD (µ$), where 1,000,000 µ$ = $1.
Deprecated. Amounts are micro-USD (µ$), where 1,000,000 µ$ = $1.

exec_credits.description: Flat cost of a workflow run, in micro-USD (µ$).

long_run_credits_per_minute.description: Per additional started minute past the included seconds, in micro-USD (µ$).
